verdict.rationale: Semgrep has a well-documented CLI (`semgrep ci`, `semgrep scan`) designed for headless/CI use, with dedicated CI provider integrations, pre-commit hooks, SARIF export, no-login/dry-run modes, and an API for programmatic access to findings—clearly supporting automated, non-interactive pipelines. Independent evidence (Zulip, Microsoft SARIF+LLM triage pipeline) confirms real-world CI/automation usage at scale. Missing for 10: no first-party benchmark of CI runtime performance at scale beyond anecdotal community complaints about slowness.
